title: THE SPINNING JAVELIN - Banned Javelin Technique
description:
The banned Javelin Throw - The Spinning Technique.

In the 1950’s Spanish Throwers discovered a way to vastly improve the distance of a javelin toss. They would Spin around in a circle to build up rotational momentum similar to a discus thrower before releasing the javelin. It became know as “spinning the javelin”

“The Spanish-Style”

But it was quickly outlawed and this technique is not allowed in competition!

(EPISODE 3)
This is the 3rd addition to: THE BANNED TECHNIQUE series where we look at unorthodox or banned techniques used in Track and Field.
